mcp_default_prompt.description: Use the MCP dispatcher with list_servers to find available servers, list_tools to discover tools, get_tool_details to retrieve all available details for a tool, and execute_tool to run it. get_tool_details returns the input schema and any title, description, output schema, MCP annotations, and task-support status supplied by the server; unavailable details are omitted. Use the server_id and tool name provided in this context or returned by discovery. Tools already described in this context do not need to be discovered again and will not appear in discovery results.

data_description.mcp_media_types: Select MCP media types that this AI endpoint can process natively. Unselected media remains available as base64 in the tool result.

embeddings_endpoint.title: Configure embeddings endpoint
embeddings_endpoint.description: Configure an optional OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint. A real embedding request is made to validate the credentials, URL, and model.

data.clear_embedding_history: Clear stored embedding history when saving

data_description.embedding_chunk_size: Maximum estimated tokens sent in one embedding input. Choose a value below the embedding model's context limit because token counts vary by model.
data_description.clear_embedding_history: This action is never saved as a setting. When selected, all embedding-backed conversation history for this endpoint will be removed when the service configuration is saved.

reranker_endpoint.title: Configure reranker endpoint
reranker_endpoint.description: Configure an optional reranker endpoint. Enter the complete request URL; no path is appended. A real reranking request validates the credentials, URL, and model.

mcp.title: Add MCP service
mcp.description: Configure a shared MCP server connection. Conversation agents can reference this server by its ID.

data_description.server_id: A short, unique ID used by conversation-agent function configuration.
data_description.description: Optional model-visible description of the server's purpose.
data_description.headers: Enter a YAML or JSON object of header names and string values. Example: Authorization: "Bearer token". Do not include an outer headers key. Quote numeric, boolean, or null-like values so they remain strings.
data_description.use_oauth: Use Home Assistant's OAuth and Application Credentials support instead of static authentication headers.
data_description.perform_tool_discovery:
Connect and cache the server's current tool catalogue when this page is submitted. Disable this to perform only a connection check.
Disabling this will prevent configuring permanent tools and disabling tools will be limited to Regular Expressions only
data_description.on_demand_discovery: Allow the model to discover non-permanent tools during conversations.

mcp_authenticate.title: OAuth settings
mcp_authenticate.description: Authenticate with the MCP server using OAuth.

data_description.oauth_timeout: Seconds to wait for the browser authorization callback. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

mcp_credentials.title: MCP OAuth application credentials
mcp_credentials.description:
The authorization server does not have reusable credentials and could not register Home Assistant automatically. Enter a client registered with this redirect URI:

`{redirect_uri}`

data_description.client_secret: Leave empty for a public PKCE client. The credentials are stored and managed by Home Assistant.

mcp_filter_tools.title: Filter MCP tools
mcp_filter_tools.description:
Apply filters on what tools to expose.
{tool_count} Tools have been discovered
Permanent tools are supplied to the AI agent on every request. Disabled tools are made unavailable to the AI agent when it performs tool discovery

data_description.permanent_tool_mode: Selected includes only the tools selected below. Unselected includes every discovered tool except those selected below.
data_description.permanent_tools: Tools used by the permanent selection behavior.
data_description.include_permanent_schemas: Include input schemas in the permanent context supplied on every request.
data_description.disabled_tool_mode: Selected disables the tools selected below. Unselected disables every discovered tool except those selected below.
data_description.disabled_tools: Tools selected for the disabled-tool filter. In selected mode, selected tools are disabled. In unselected mode, every tool except the selected tools is disabled.
data_description.tool_name_pattern: Full match regular expression to filter tools during on-demand discovery. Any tools that match this regex will be unavailable and hidden from the AI agent during on demand discovery. Leave empty for no regular-expression restriction.
data_description.regex_timeout: Maximum seconds allowed for each hard-filter regular-expression match before it returns no results.

mcp_review.title: Review MCP context

data.max_tokens: Maximum tokens to return in response

data_description.prompt: Use the `permanent_mcp_tools` Jinja variable to insert the assigned permanent MCP tool catalogues and `default_mcp_prompt` to insert the localized MCP usage instructions.
data_description.mcp_auto_add_permanent_tools: Automatically add permanent MCP tool catalogues as separate system messages. Enabling this while inserting `permanent_mcp_tools` will duplicate the catalogue.
data_description.mcp_auto_add_default_prompt: Automatically add the MCP usage instructions as a separate system message. Enabling this while inserting `default_mcp_prompt` will duplicate the instructions.

data.clear_intra_turn_embeddings: Clear temporary intra-turn context when saving

data_description.shorten_tool_call_id: Required for Mistral AI cloud API compatibility. Enable only if your provider requires short (9-character) tool call IDs. Keep disabled for OpenAI and most other providers.
data_description.context_compaction_target: Maximum active prompt size in tokens after compaction. The summary and retained context must fit within this target.
data_description.context_compaction_intra_turn: Allow the selected context strategy to reduce completed tool-call exchanges during an active turn when the request would otherwise exceed the context threshold.
data_description.clear_intra_turn_embeddings: This action is never saved as a setting. When selected, all temporary intra-turn archived context for this agent is removed when the agent configuration is saved.
data_description.context_compaction_recent_turns: Number of complete recent conversation turns to keep verbatim after compaction. Tool calls and results remain together.
data_description.context_compaction_prompt: Instructions used to summarize older conversation history. The transcript and token limit are supplied separately.
data_description.embedding_history_retention: Retention shared by semantic embedding and literal text recall archives. Enter a positive whole number followed by m for minutes, h for hours, or d for days. With no suffix, days are used. Examples: 10m, 5h, 50d, or 30.
data_description.context_keyword_recall_max_tokens: Maximum estimated tokens returned on each literal-search page. Oversized matching messages are split into ordered verbatim fragments.
data_description.context_recall_max_tokens: Maximum total estimated tokens of embedding-derived context retained in any model request, including automatic recall, context_recall results, and browsed snapshot pages.
data_description.context_recall_max_results: Maximum number of memories the model may request from context_recall. The model may request fewer. Defaults to 20.
data_description.context_recall_close_match_tolerance: Report excluded memories whose score is within this amount of the lowest selected result. Leave empty to disable. Enter a number greater than 0 to enable. Score ranges depend on the active embedding or reranker model.
data_description.context_recall_rerank: Rerank embedding-selected recall candidates before returning or automatically injecting them.
data_description.context_recall_rerank_min_score: Discard reranked results below this score. Leave empty to accept all results. Score ranges depend on the configured reranker model.
data_description.context_recall_rerank_max_candidate_toke: Maximum estimated tokens from each matched embedding chunk sent to the reranker. Leave empty to send the complete matched chunk.
data_description.context_recall_snapshot_ttl_turns: Number of subsequent user turns for which a truncated recall snapshot remains available. Leave blank to disable turn-based expiry. Successfully browsing the snapshot resets its lifetime.
data_description.context_recall_snapshot_ttl_time: Maximum time a recall snapshot remains available. Enter a positive whole number followed by m for minutes, h for hours, or d for days. With no suffix, days are used. Successfully browsing the snapshot resets this lifetime.
